title: tephroseris rivularis
intro: Tephroseris rivularis, commonly known as Alpine Marsh Gentian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Alpine Marsh Gentian include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects.
